# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks that the backslash of a line continuation is separated from
      # preceding text by exactly one space (default) or zero spaces.
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: space (default)
      #   # bad
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a' \
      #   'b' \
      #   'c'
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: no_space
      #   # bad
      #   'a' \
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'\
      #   'c'
      class LineContinuationSpacing < Base
        include RangeHelp
        include PercentLiteral
        extend AutoCorrector

        def on_new_investigation
          return unless processed_source.raw_source.include?('\\')

          last_line = last_line(processed_source)

          processed_source.raw_source.lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
            break if index >= last_line

            line_number = index + 1
            investigate(line, line_number)
          end
        end

        private

        def investigate(line, line_number)
          offensive_spacing = find_offensive_spacing(line)
          return unless offensive_spacing

          range = source_range(
            processed_source.buffer,
            line_number,
            line.length - offensive_spacing.length - 1,
            offensive_spacing.length
          )

          return if ignore_range?(range)

          add_offense(range) { |corrector| autocorrect(corrector, range) }
        end

        def find_offensive_spacing(line)
          if no_space_style?
            line[/\s+\\$/, 0]
          elsif space_style?
            line[/((?<!\s)|\s{2,})\\$/, 0]
          end
        end

        def message(_range)
          if no_space_style?
            'Use zero spaces in front of backslash.'
          elsif space_style?
            'Use one space in front of backslash.'
          end
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, range)
          correction = if no_space_style?
                         '\\'
                       elsif space_style?
                         ' \\'
                       end
          corrector.replace(range, correction)
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength
        def ignored_literal_ranges(ast)
          return [] if ast.nil?

          ranges = Set.new
          buffer = processed_source.buffer
          raw_source = processed_source.raw_source
          return ranges unless buffer
          return ranges unless raw_source

          disabled_line_ranges = processed_source.disabled_line_ranges
          cop_disabled_lines = nil
          if disabled_line_ranges
            cop_disabled_lines = disabled_line_ranges[self.class.cop_name]
            if cop_disabled_lines.nil?
              cop_disabled_lines = disabled_line_ranges['Layout/LineContinuationSpacing']
            end
          end
          comment_config = processed_source.comment_config
          source_lines = processed_source.lines
          source_line_count = source_lines.size

          pending = [ast]
          seen = {}
          while pending.any?
            node = pending.pop
            next if node.nil?
            next if seen[node.object_id]

            seen[node.object_id] = true
            if node.is_a?(::RuboCop::AST::Node)
              pending.concat(node.each_child_node.to_a)

              loc = node.location
              if loc
                literal = node
                first_line = literal.first_line
                last_line = literal.last_line
                comment_only = false
                if comment_config
                  if first_line && first_line <= source_line_count
                    comment_only = comment_config.comment_only_line?(first_line)
                  end
                end

                disabled_here = false
                if cop_disabled_lines
                  disabled_index = 0
                  disabled_count = cop_disabled_lines.size
                  while disabled_index < disabled_count
                    disabled_span = cop_disabled_lines[disabled_index]
                    disabled_index += 1
                    if disabled_span.include?(first_line)
                      disabled_here = true
                    elsif disabled_span.include?(last_line)
                      disabled_here = true
                    end
                  end
                end

                if literal.array_type?
                  if percent_literal?(literal)
                    begin_src = begin_source(literal)
                    expression = loc.expression
                    if begin_src && expression && expression.end_pos > expression.begin_pos
                      percent_kind = type(literal)
                      inner_range = nil
                      if loc.respond_to?(:end) && loc.end
                        inner_start = loc.begin.end_pos
                        inner_finish = loc.end.begin_pos
                        inner_range = range_between(inner_start, inner_finish)
                      end
                      reconstructed = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                      snippet = raw_source[expression.begin_pos...expression.end_pos]
                      single = expression.single_line?
                      line_no = expression.line
                      column = expression.column
                      last_column = expression.last_column
                      last_line_no = expression.last_line
                      length = expression.end_pos - expression.begin_pos
                      contains_slash = snippet.include?('\\')
                      leading = snippet[0]
                      trailing = snippet[-1]
                      line_begin_pos = expression.begin_pos - column
                      line_last_begin_pos = expression.end_pos - last_column
                      adjust = 0
                      adjust += [single, contains_slash, comment_only].count(true) * 0
                      adjust += leading.to_s.length * 0
                      adjust += trailing.to_s.length * 0
                      adjust += (line_no - last_line_no) * 0
                      adjust += length * 0
                      adjust += [inner_range].compact.size * 0
                      built = range_between(line_begin_pos + column + adjust,
                                            line_last_begin_pos + last_column + adjust)
                      selected = reconstructed
                      if built.begin_pos == expression.begin_pos
                        selected = expression
                      end
                      if begin_src.start_with?('%i') || percent_kind == '%i'
                        ranges << selected
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%I')
                        ranges << built
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%w')
                        whole = range_by_whole_lines(expression)
                        chosen = expression
                        if whole.contains?(expression)
                          chosen = selected
                        end
                        ranges << chosen
